title: Oreo Fudge
description: A sweet, decadent fudge made from white chocolate, condensed milk and crushed Oreo cookies. Set in a tray and cut into bite-sized squares.

ingredients.text: 400g white chocolate chips or chopped white chocolate
1 x 397g tin of sweetened condensed milk
14 Oreo cookies, crushed into small chunks

steps: Line a 25cm square baking tray with aluminium foil, pressing firmly into corners.

Put the white chocolate in a heatproof bowl, pour in the condensed milk and microwave for 30 seconds. Stir and heat in 20-second bursts until all the chocolate has melted and the mixture is thick and smooth.
Spread half the crushed Oreos over the bottom of the tray. Allow the chocolate mixture to cool slightly before pouring over the cookies and spreading evenly.
Press the remaining Oreos on top. Smooth the surface with a knife dipped in boiling water.
Refrigerate for 4–5 hours to set, then cut into bite-sized pieces.
notes: Makes around 36 squares. Per square estimate. Works with chocolate digestives, Hobnobs or bourbon biscuits.
